source.title: AI SDK
source.description: TypeScript toolkit for LLM apps where `generateText` swaps providers via a unified `provider/model` string, `generateObject`/`streamObject` constrain output to a `zod` schema, plus `tool()` calling and streaming to React/Next.js frontends.

source.title: Build a fullstack app with Next.js 16 and Prisma Postgres
source.description: Tutorial building a blog with `App Router` pages, Prisma ORM schema and queries, Sign in with Vercel `OAuth` (PKCE, `jose` ID-token verification), `Server Actions` for drafts/publishing, and `vercel` CLI deployment.

source.title: Agent Resources
source.description: Machine-readable `llms-full.txt`, per-page `.md` Markdown Access, the `MCP` server linking AI assistants to your Vercel account, AI Gateway coding agents, Skills.sh (`npx skills add`), and CLI workflows for AI-assisted development.
